name: ZCH_DATA_MGMT_ERR_RSLTS
description: This table table stores the errors/conflicts and resolutions in data management processes. It is meant to store different errors from different source processes. Duplication resolution is one of the source processes.

columns.name: PARENT_OBJ_DEF
columns.description: The error occurs in the context of a parent entity.

columns.name: ERROR_DATE_TIME
columns.description: The date/time the error occurs. If it is NULL, it is the same as creation time.

columns.name: ERROR_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: The status of the error/conflict. Unresolved when insert. Resolved when interpreted by UI

columns.name: ERROR_CAUSE_ACTION_CODE
columns.description: The action/operation which causes the error. For example, merge, transfer, or update, insert, delete.

columns.name: RESOLUTION_ACTION_CODE
columns.description: The resolution applied to the error. For example, ignore, reapply et al.

columns.name: DETAIL_ERROR
columns.description: The detail error message

columns.name: SOURCE_PROC_TYPE
columns.description: The process which created this error. For example, merge, unmerge.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: ERROR_CODE
columns.description: for example FND lookup code, FND message name or JBO error code returned by JboMessage#getErrorCode

columns.name: ERROR_DETAIL
columns.description: for example Java stacktrace of JBO exception, similar to ERROR_WARNING_DETAIL in ESS request history

columns.name: ERROR_SEVERITY
columns.description: for example based on JBO error severity returned by JboException#getSeverity

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.
